description_en: Enables or disables the whitelist of a listener
description_zh: 是否开启指定监听的白名单访问控制
kebab_example: aliyun slb set-listener-access-control-status --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --load-balancer-id lb-8vb86hxixo8lvsja80000 --listener-port 80 --access-control-status open_white_list --api-version 2014-05-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetListenerAccessControlStatus

parameters.help_en:
The region where the Classic Load Balancer (CLB) instance is created.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/27584.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
负载均衡实例的地域。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/27584.html接口查询地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the CLB instance
parameters.name: load_balancer_id

parameters.help_en:
The frontend port that is used by the CLB instance.

Valid values: 1 to 65535
parameters.help_zh:
负载均衡实例前端使用的端口。

取值：1-65535
parameters.name: listener_port

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the whitelist. Valid values:

open_white_list: enables the whitelist.

close: disables the whitelist.

After the whitelist is enabled, if no IP address is added to the whitelist, the CLB instance does not distribute network traffic
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启访问控制。取值：

open_white_list：开启白名单访问控制。

close：关闭白名单访问控制。

如果开启访问控制后，没有设置白名单则无法访问负载均衡服务
parameters.name: access_control_status

parameters.help_en:
The frontend protocol that is used by the CLB instance.

This parameter is required when listeners that use different protocols listen on the same port
parameters.help_zh:
负载均衡实例前端使用的协议。
相同端口存在不同协议监听时，此字段必填
parameters.name: listener_protocol
